description: This file defines an enumeration 'NoteType' representing different types of notes within the Fineract system context. It includes various constants for each note type, methods for conversion and lookup, and data to facilitate integration with the system's API and UI components.

classes.name: NoteType
classes.description: An enum representing various categories of notes, with properties for id, code, API URL, and description, along with utility methods for conversions and lookups.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the note type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string identifying the note type.

methods.name: getApiUrl
methods.description: Returns the API URL string for the note type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the note type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Retrieves a NoteType based on its integer value.

methods.name: fromApiUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a NoteType based on its API URL.

methods.name: toEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts a NoteType or its ID to an EnumOptionData object for UI or external representation.

methods.name: toEnumOptionData (instance method)
methods.description: Converts this NoteType instance into an EnumOptionData object.
